cases.request: 고급 호텔 로비에서 근무하는 여성 직원 한 명의 세련된 광고 화보 6장. 같은 인물과 의상, 장소를 유지하면서 구도와 행동을 의미 있게 변화시킨다.

actors.identity: adult woman, dark brown bob cut, amber eyes
actors.outfit: burgundy hotel uniform jacket, white blouse, navy pencil skirt

constraints: Keep the same hotel lobby, identity, and outfit in every shot.
Use six visually distinct but minimally directed editorial compositions.
No other people are part of the intended scene.

cases.request: 호텔 프런트에서 여성 매니저와 남성 컨시어지가 함께 장부를 확인하고 인계하는 2인 광고 화보 6장. 두 사람의 상호작용과 좌우 배치를 명확하게 보여준다.

actors.identity: adult woman, long black hair, gray eyes
adult man, short auburn hair, green eyes
actors.outfit: navy concierge jacket, gold trim, white shirt

constraints: Every shot contains exactly both declared actors in preset order.
Keep character prompt order and normalized x positions left-to-right consistent.
Show a clear shared-ledger interaction or coordinated attention in every shot.
Vary framing, placement, or action without changing identities or outfits.

cases.request: 한 명의 여성 기록 보관 담당자가 조용한 기록실에 들어와 선반에서 장부를 꺼내고, 책상으로 옮겨 펼친 뒤 기록을 대조하고 메모를 남기는 6컷 연속 장면.

actors.identity: adult woman, wavy chestnut hair, blue eyes, round glasses
actors.outfit: cream cardigan, pale blue shirt, dark slacks

constraints: Use exactly six chronological actions: enter, approach shelf, remove ledger, carry to desk and open, compare records, write a note.
Track the same ledger and its state across every shot.
Every shot after shot_001 carries state from an earlier shot.
Keep identity, outfit, and archive room continuous.

cases.request: 기하학적 현대 미술관에서 남성 무용수 한 명의 비대칭 화보 6장. 강한 오버헤드, 바닥 가까운 로우 앵글, 화면 모서리의 비정상적 배치, 전경 구조물과 먼 배경의 층위를 포함하되 인물과 의상은 유지한다.

actors.identity: adult man, cropped black hair, sharp dark eyes
actors.outfit: black contemporary dance costume, fitted long sleeves

constraints: Across the set, include at least one strong overhead shot and one floor-level low-angle shot.
Use an unusual edge or corner placement in at least one shot.
Use foreground architecture and a clearly distant background in at least one shot.
Maintain asymmetric composition without inventing another actor.
